standard.summary: H3 CFG 保真训练使用的 guidance 强度，范围 1~16，推荐并默认 4。
standard.effect: 作为 raw conditional 目标反解公式里的 s：target = 输出与 uncond 按 s 的线性组合。等于 1 时保真路径不激活（无 guidance 可言）。
standard.whenToUse: 保持默认 4（已验证值）；如果你的推理端固定用其它 guidance，理论上可对齐，但缺乏验证数据时不建议偏离。
standard.avoidWhen: h3_cfg_preservation_enabled 关闭时无效；超出 [1,16] 会被配置校验拒绝。

standard_en.summary: The guidance strength used by H3 CFG-faithful training, range 1-16, recommended and defaulting to 4.
standard_en.effect: It is the s in the formula that solves back for the raw conditional target: target = a linear combination of the output and uncond weighted by s. At 1 the faithful path never activates (there is no guidance to speak of).
standard_en.whenToUse: Keep the default of 4 (the verified value). If your inference side always uses another guidance value you could in principle align to it, but without verification data straying is not advised.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It has no effect when h3_cfg_preservation_enabled is off, and a value outside [1,16] is rejected by config validation.

advanced.principle: 蒸馏权重内嵌的有效 guidance 是训练时固定的；反解 raw conditional 需要假设一个 s 值，s 与蒸馏时的真实值越接近，重构的目标越准确。4 是该 checkpoint 家族的实测校准值。
advanced.intervention: minimax_h3/train_step.py：configured_cfg_scale 参与 preserve_cfg 激活判定与目标重构；configs_h3.py：Field(ge=1, le=16) 校验。
advanced.expectedImpact: 正确的 s 下长训不损伤内嵌 guidance；偏差过大的 s 会引入系统性目标误差。
advanced.tradeoffs: s 不可从 checkpoint 直接读出，只能依赖校准经验值；改动后建议用固定 seed 预览对比验证。

advanced_en.principle: The effective guidance embedded in distilled weights is fixed at their training time; back-solving the raw conditional requires assuming an s value — the closer s is to the true distillation value, the more accurate the reconstructed target. 4 is the measured calibration for this checkpoint family.
advanced_en.intervention: minimax_h3/train_step.py: configured_cfg_scale participates in the preserve_cfg activation check and target reconstruction; configs_h3.py: Field(ge=1, le=16) validation.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: With the correct s, long runs do not damage the embedded guidance; a badly off s introduces systematic target error.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: s cannot be read directly from the checkpoint and relies on calibration experience; after changing it, verify with fixed-seed preview comparisons.
advanced_en.codePath: minimax_h3/train_step.py: configured_cfg_scale usage; configs_h3.py: h3_cfg_scale range validation
